title: Structured Programming
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in bit level programming."
Bitwise operators are used in bit level programming.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the reduction of a particular body of data to a simplified representation of the whole."
Data abstraction is the reduction of a particular body of data to a simplified representation of the whole.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a block of organized, reusable code that is used to perform a single, related action."
A function is a block of organized, reusable code that is used to perform a single, related action.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a standardized collection of header files and library routines used to implement common operations, such as input/output and character string handling."
The C standard library is a standardized collection of header files and library routines used to implement common operations, such as input/output and character string handling.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a declaration of a function that specifies the function's name and type signature (arity, data types of parameters, and return type), but omits the function body."
Function interface is a declaration of a function that specifies the function's name and type signature (arity, data types of parameters, and return type), but omits the function body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a combination of operators, operands and/or constants which reduces to a single value."
An expression is a combination of operators, operands and/or constants which reduces to a single value.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an artificial language which is used in writing a set of formal instructions to control the activities of a computer system."
A computer programming language is an artificial language which is used in writing a set of formal instructions to control the activities of a computer system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the words whose meaning has already been explained to the C compiler."
Keywords are the words whose meaning has already been explained to the C compiler.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most commonly used to display out and take input respectively."
Functions printf() and scanf() are the most commonly used to display out and take input respectively.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an object in many programming languages that stores a memory address."
A pointer is an object in many programming languages that stores a memory address.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a structure-oriented programming language, developed at Bell Laboratories in 1972 by Dennis Ritchie."
C programming language is a structure-oriented programming language, developed at Bell Laboratories in 1972 by Dennis Ritchie.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a character type array which holds 20 characters."
Grade is a character type array which holds 20 characters.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a symbol that tells the compiler to perform specific mathematical or logical manipulations."
An operator is a symbol that tells the compiler to perform specific mathematical or logical manipulations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to realize programming paradigms."
Programming languages are used to realize programming paradigms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for holding the variables of varied data types under one name."
The structure is used for holding the variables of varied data types under one name.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the way data is stored in the machine and the functions used to access that data."
A data structure is the way data is stored in the machine and the functions used to access that data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of subdividing a computer program into separate sub-programs."
Modular programming is the process of subdividing a computer program into separate sub-programs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a revolutionary idea and there are a number of reasons why it has become the dominant programming paradigm in the last few decades."
OOP is a revolutionary idea and there are a number of reasons why it has become the dominant programming paradigm in the last few decades.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to represent a record."
Structures are used to represent a record.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a programming principle that allows for the hiding of details of the task at hand."
Abstraction is a programming principle that allows for the hiding of details of the task at hand.
fib: ______ refer to the goto statement as "infinitely abusable" and suggest that it "be used sparingly, if at all.
Kernighan and Ritchie
Kernighan and Ritchie refer to the goto statement as "infinitely abusable" and suggest that it "be used sparingly, if at all.
______ is a method to organize large programs in smaller parts, i.e., the modules.
Modularization
Modularization is a method to organize large programs in smaller parts, i.e., the modules.
______ is an entity that doesn't change whereas a variable is an entity that may change.
constant
A constant is an entity that doesn't change whereas a variable is an entity that may change.
______ are used in decision making in C programming, i.e., executes different statements according to test condition whether it is either true or false.
Conditional operators
Conditional operators are used in decision making in C programming, i.e., executes different statements according to test condition whether it is either true or false.
______ is used to take input from user.
scanf() function
scanf function
The scanf() function is used to take input from user.
______ is a set of instruction given to a computer to carry out a particular task.
computer program
A computer program is a set of instruction given to a computer to carry out a particular task.
______ is defined as a contiguous sequence of code units terminated by the first zero code unit (often called the NUL code unit).
string
A string is defined as a contiguous sequence of code units terminated by the first zero code unit (often called the NUL code unit).
______ is a finite set of sequenced instructions or commands given to a computer in order to carry out a particular task.
program
A program is a finite set of sequenced instructions or commands given to a computer in order to carry out a particular task.
______ is used to protect internal properties of an object.
Information hiding
Information hiding is used to protect internal properties of an object.
______ is a data structure that is a collection of variables of one type that are accessed through a common name.
array
An array is a data structure that is a collection of variables of one type that are accessed through a common name.
______ is the name given to a memory location that allows values to be stored in those locations.
variable
A variable is the name given to a memory location that allows values to be stored in those locations.
______ is a group of variables of different data types represented by a single name.
structure in C Programming language
A structure in C Programming language is a group of variables of different data types represented by a single name.
______ is a special program designed to translate a program written in assembly language to a machine language equivalent.
Assembler
Assembler is a special program designed to translate a program written in assembly language to a machine language equivalent.
______ is a protocol (rules) to the programmer, which he has to follow while writing a C program.
structure of a C program
The structure of a C program is a protocol (rules) to the programmer, which he has to follow while writing a C program.
______ are the primary building blocks of a program.
Statements
Statements are the primary building blocks of a program.
______ is an executable instruction given to the computer to execute.
statement
A statement is an executable instruction given to the computer to execute.
______ is a blue print for the production of objects.
Class
Class is a blue print for the production of objects.
______ are the Machine language and the Assembly language.
two major examples
The two major examples are the Machine language and the Assembly language.
______ is used to select a particular member of the structure.
dot operator
The dot operator is used to select a particular member of the structure.
